custom_logic_notes: X2 variant adds additional signal filtering layer on top of IBS+RSI+CCI combination. Uses TradeAlgorithms.mqh for order execution abstraction. IBS (Internal Bar Strength) is a custom indicator measuring where the close sits relative to the bar's range - this is not a built-in MT5 indicator and must be replicated in Python. The EA likely uses previous bar values ([1]) for signal generation to avoid repainting. Digit adjustment logic multiplies SL/TP by 10 when the symbol has 5 digits or _Point < 0.001.
python_conversion_notes: 1) IBS indicator must be manually implemented: IBS = (Close - Low) / (High - Low) for each bar. 2) Custom X2 signal filter logic must be reverse-engineered from the iCustom call - need to find the .ex5 indicator or its source. 3) Digit adjustment: when price has 5 decimal places, multiply SL/TP pip values by 10. 4) TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides trade execution wrappers - replace with direct broker API calls. 5) New bar detection must be replicated. 6) The conditional money management (negative=fixlots, positive=fraction) must be preserved. 7) Signal uses previous completed bar values, not current bar - critical to avoid lookahead bias in backtesting.
